name: Camera viewfinder over the speaker
description: A camera viewfinder laid over the speaker: four white corner brackets framing the picture, a blinking red dot with 'REC' top-left, a running timecode top-right, small mono camera specs bottom-left and a battery with '87%' bottom-right; an orange face-tracking bracket snaps onto the speaker's face with a 'FACE · AF LOCK' tag.
use_when: Lines about recording, filming, being on camera, hitting record, shooting content or 'this is me recording right now'; it can run long under a whole section about filming.

labels.help: mono camera specs bottom-left; empty hides the chip

face_lock.help: show the orange face-tracking bracket around the speaker's face

start_tc.help: seconds the timecode starts at (it counts up in real time)
